foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Breakfast (All Days)
foodRoutines.instructions: 7:00 AM — Same every day (Mon-Sun). Take fish oil + multivitamin with this meal — fat from eggs and PB helps absorb both.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Mid-Morning Snack (10 AM)
foodRoutines.instructions: 10:00 AM — Every day. Prep in a container the night before. Take to office Fri so you don't reach for junk. 5 almonds also fine if preferred.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Lunch - Soya + Rice + Veg (All Training Days)
foodRoutines.instructions: 12:30 PM (Tue-Fri, Sun) | 2:00 PM (Monday — after HIIT). Rice fuels afternoon training. Cook soya in bulk for the week to save time.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Dinner - Soya + Veg (All Days)
foodRoutines.instructions: 7:00 PM (Tue-Fri, Sun) | 5:30 PM Monday (before badminton — no rice so stomach stays light for 7:30 PM play). High protein, low carb end to the day.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Sat Legs B Lunch - Soya + Rice + Veg (Morning Workout)
foodRoutines.instructions: 1:30 PM Saturday — MORNING WORKOUT DAY: Rice included — you trained 6:30-8:00 AM so carbs are earned. Same as weekday lunch. If grocery shopping today, eat this FIRST before you go.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Pre-Workout Banana (30 min before gym — flexible 12 or 3 PM)
foodRoutines.instructions: 2:30 PM (Tue-Fri, Sun) — 30 min before 3 PM gym. | 11:45 AM Monday — before 12:30 PM HIIT class.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Post-Workout Whey (immediately after gym — all training days)

meals.name: PVL Iso Gold Whey (1 scoop with water)

foodRoutines.instructions: 4:30 PM (Tue-Fri, Sun) — right after gym. | 1:30 PM Monday — right after HIIT class. Don't skip — muscle recovery window.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Post-Badminton Greek Yogurt (Monday night only)
foodRoutines.instructions: 10:00 PM Monday — after badminton (7:30-10 PM). Light protein before bed. Yogurt over whey — easier on sleep. Keep it small.

foodRoutines.name: CARB SWAP: Idli (3 pieces)
foodRoutines.instructions: Rice swap: ~174 cal vs rice 156 cal. Closest calorie match to rice. Use with sambar or coconut chutney (add those calories separately). Works for any meal.

foodRoutines.name: CARB SWAP: Plain Dosa (2 pieces)
foodRoutines.instructions: Rice swap: ~220 cal vs rice 156 cal. Slightly more carbs + fat. Keep it plain (no butter/ghee) to stay lean. Works for any meal.

foodRoutines.name: CARB SWAP: Chapati / Roti (2 pieces)
foodRoutines.instructions: Rice swap: ~202 cal vs rice 156 cal. Fewer carbs than rice, slightly more fat. Pairs well with dal or soya curry. Use dry (no ghee) to save ~45 cal.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Lunch - Soya + Idli + Veg
foodRoutines.instructions: SHRED lunch swap — 487 cal vs 469 cal (rice version). +18 cal, virtually identical. Best rice alternative for shred days.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Lunch - Soya + Dosa + Veg
foodRoutines.instructions: SHRED lunch swap — 533 cal vs 469 cal (rice version). +64 cal. Keep dosa plain, no coconut chutney or butter on shred days.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Lunch - Soya + Chapati + Veg
foodRoutines.instructions: SHRED lunch swap — 515 cal vs 469 cal (rice version). +46 cal, slightly fewer carbs. Best when you want something lighter on carbs.

foodRoutines.name: SHRED: Sunday Rest Day Snack - Greek Yogurt (replaces banana + whey)
foodRoutines.instructions: SUNDAY REST DAY ONLY. No gym = no banana, no whey. Use this snack instead (afternoon, around 2-3 PM). Sunday total: ~1,507 cal. Use with: Breakfast + Lunch (full rice) + This snack + Dinner.
